title: His marriages: the first wife from Seminole
summary: Tate married at 17 or 18 a girl from Seminole, Oklahoma, who died of tuberculosis.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: When did you get married?
Well, in '36. See, I got married in '36 in Omaha. But I had been married before then.
Really?
Uh-huh.
How old?
I've been married all my life.
(Laughter.)
I've been married three different times. The first wife died.
How old were you then?
Well, I had to marry, you know, the first time and she was only 20.
And you?
I was about, I guess, 18. Yeah, about 17, 18. And, of course, -- a very lovely girl.
What did she die of?

T.B. She was an Indian girl from Seminole, Oklahoma. And they have a lot of T.B., those Indians did. Her family was kind of tuberculous. She didn't look it, but she did, you know, had tuberculosis. And of course, then the wife I'm with now, we married in '36.
Where did you meet her?
In Omaha. Omaha, Nebraska.
Did you have a child with the first wife?
Yeah, but I don't know. After she died, it went back to her people.
So you don't know the child?

I really don't know him. Actually, he wrote and told me he was going in the Army, he was about that age and this would be World War II and after that, I never knew. I never knew what happened to him. I guess he's with some of her people in Oklahoma, if he's still alive. I really don't know. I don't know what happened after he went to the Army.
